title: Nvidia Stock Earnings Preview: What to Watch on Nov. 17
summary: Nvidia stock heads into Q3 FY2027 earnings on Nov. 17, its first report since Jensen Huang resigned, with a $108 billion revenue outlook.
body_markdown:
Analysts expect adjusted EPS of $2.49 for the third quarter, up from $1.24 a year earlier, according to[Barchart](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/expect-nvidias-next-quarterly-earnings-151739351.html) , which noted that Nvidia beat Wall Street's earnings expectations in each of the past four quarters. Tuesday's[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) will be presented by interim CEO Kress, per[investingLive](https://investinglive.com/stocks/weekend-bessent-urges-nvidia-to-hire-an-outsider-ceo-pouring-cold-water-on-a-huang-comeback/) .


## Why Did Nvidia Stock Fall After Huang Resigned?


Huang resigned on November 12 after revelations about his relationship with Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive whom U.S. intelligence officials suspect of spying for China, as reported by[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/15/bessent-nvidia-ceo-lutnick-megaspeed.html) . Megaspeed is suspected of diverting Nvidia chips to China in violation of export controls, CNBC reported.


Nvidia's stock plunged more than 13% at the open on Thursday and hit a new 52-week low early in the session before it[closed down 4.3%](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-13-2026/) , according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html) .


Other chip stocks moved the other way.[Advanced Micro Devices (AMD)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) rose 3% after Huang stepped down, and[Broadcom (AVGO)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/avgo/) jumped more than 5%, per CNBC.


Analysts split on what the exit means. KeyBanc's John Vinh said the departure represents "a material increase in strategic, organizational, and execution risk," CNBC reported, while Janus Henderson's Jeremiah Buckley offered a different read:


> "I think you could argue, given where the stock is, that this could be a clearing event for the company." Jeremiah Buckley, Janus Henderson, as quoted by CNBC


## Bessent Calls for "Dramatic Shakeup" Before Nvidia Earnings


Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday that Nvidia needs a "dramatic shakeup" and that its board should look outside the company for its next CEO, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/15/bessent-nvidia-ceo-lutnick-megaspeed.html) . "I want to keep coming back to what was the culture at Nvidia, and were they pressing these seemingly illicit sales to goose their revenues and their earnings?" Bessent said in a Fox News interview.


Bessent asked the board and outside counsel for answers within 10 days on whether Nvidia ignored warning signs that shell companies were routing its AI chips to China, per[investingLive](https://investinglive.com/stocks/weekend-bessent-urges-nvidia-to-hire-an-outsider-ceo-pouring-cold-water-on-a-huang-comeback/) .


His remarks came the same day the Financial Times reported that Huang has been discussing a return, with Silicon Valley allies assembling a "war room" to build support, investingLive reported. Nvidia and a Huang spokesperson declined to comment to the FT.


Nvidia's board will consider internal and external candidates for a permanent CEO, the company said, and Jones said the board expects "the company's operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption." Huang has agreed to testify before lawmakers behind closed doors, according to investingLive.
